TITLE: Apple Reminders
DESC: Apple Reminders CLI for AI agents: list, search and (policy-gated) create/complete reminders via EventKit.
INJECTION: Static JXA script (`go:embed`). Input travels only as one JSON argv element to `/usr/bin/osascript` (absolute path), and fuzz tests check the script is never altered by input. An integration test round-trips hostile strings through real osascript.
SECRETS: No credentials involved; macOS TCC controls access.
